mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( name, email, password, self_introduction, avatar_image, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{email}, #{password}, #{selfIntroduction}, #{avatarImage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, password, self_introduction, avatar_image, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
